label: rem:figure-eight-muon-anchor-reading
title: The figure-eight rotation and the muon anchor
html: The muon-anchor identity m_\mu / m_\mathfrak{e} = \mathrm{Vol}(4_1) / \hbar_q^2 relies on the hyperbolic volume of the figure-eight complement, which the volume conjecture relates to the Kashaev limit of the figure-eight rotation. This is the point at which the rotation of V_{(2,1)} meets a measured quantity: the ratio m_\mu/m_\mathfrak{e} is compared with experiment, and that comparison, not the proposition, carries the empirical claim.
